The '''Port Sarim jail''' is a top security prison located in [[Port Sarim]], commonly referred to as the worst jail in [[Gielinor]]. Players can get sent to the jail by [[Shantay]] should they declare themselves an outlaw and refuse to pay his fine of five [[coins]] twice, although they can escape quite easily by picking the lock on the [[Door (Port Sarim jail)|door]] or [[Teleportation|teleporting]] out. Picking the lock to get out awards 4 [[Thieving]] [[experience]] on [[members]]' worlds, while not providing any experience on [[free-to-play]] worlds.

==Personalities==
Port Sarim jail is home to many criminals and outlaws, all standing in their cells looking bored, or hopefully rethinking their lives.

===Mugger===
A level 6 [[mugger]] is found in his cell, with stats identical to any other mugger within [[Gielinor]].

===Wormbrain===
In [[Dragon Slayer I]], players need to speak to [[Wormbrain]] to obtain the third map piece needed to sail to [[Crandor]]. Players have the choice of paying him 10,000 coins for the map piece or killing him and using the [[Telekinetic Grab]] spell (level 33 [[Magic]]) to get the map piece he drops.

===Pirate===
The level 23 [[pirate]] is found in his cell in the jail, waiting faithfully for the moment when he will rule the seas once again. He is roomed with [[Cap'n Hand]], who used to be part of the "Lost Pirate" [[Random events|Random event]].

===Black Knight===
This Black Knight is a different entity from its counterparts in the [[Black Knights' Fortress (location)|Black Knights' Fortress]] and the rest of Gielinor, that has no drops besides [[remains]], nor contributes to [[White equipment#Knight rankings|white knight rank]]; see [[Black knight (Port Sarim jail)]] for details.

===Thief===
A man of no honour, this [[thief]] is the average level 16 version that can be found on the streets of southern [[Varrock]].

===Guard===
On the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}, a [[Guard (Port Sarim, sleeping)|sleeping guard]] can be found. On the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}, the [[Security Guard|Security guard]] can be found, providing players with the [[Security book]] when spoken to. In addition, there are several attackable [[Guard (Port Sarim jail)|guards]]. On the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}}, "carefully watching" over the jail is an unattackable [[Guard (Port Sarim)|guard]] who has amusing dialogues when interacted with.

==Trivia==
* Cap'n Hand's name is a parody of Cap'n Hook, the pirate villain from Peter Pan.
* When you talk to the sleeping jail guard, he will talk in his sleep and will say "Guh....Mwww...Zzzzz...," followed by "mmm donuts" then "mmm big pint of beer. kebab" which is most likely a reference to Homer Simpson.
* Even though the prison guard is supposedly asleep, his eyes appear open.
* The bald, masked mugger can be seen hitting the walls as if trying to find an escape route. It sometimes happens when he is in the centre of the room, making him look as if he is angry with someone.
* In ''RuneScape 3'', [[Rick Turpentine]] can also be found in the same cell as the mugger.
* The [[Black knight (Port Sarim jail)|Black knight]] in this jail still retains the appearance prior to the graphical update the rest got on July 24, [[2007]] when [[King's Ransom]] was released.
